description: Move image conversion from frontend to backend, create Go worker package, implement Redis queue with asynq, plan Redis session migration

comments.author: renzynx
comments.text:
Created comprehensive implementation plan in Obsidian:
- Projects/Docix/Backend Image Processing Plan.md
- Projects/Docix/Redis Session Migration Plan.md  
- Projects/Docix/ADR-001 - Redis Infrastructure.md
- Projects/Docix/Implementation Checklist.md

Key technology choices:
- asynq (github.com/hibiken/asynq) for Redis job queue
- bimg (github.com/h2non/bimg) for image processing with libvips
- go-redis (github.com/redis/go-redis/v9) for Redis client

6-week implementation timeline across 4 phases.

title: Phase 3: Server upload handler integration

title: Phase 1: Redis infrastructure package
description: Create packages/go/redis with shared client, configuration, and health check. Add Redis to docker-compose.

comments.author: renzynx
comments.text:
Phase 1 implementation complete:
- Created packages/go/redis with client.go, config.go, redis_test.go
- Singleton pattern with thread-safe initialization
- Environment config: REDIS_URL or REDIS_HOST/PORT/PASSWORD/DB/POOL_SIZE
- Health check function for monitoring
- Unit tests passing (TestConfig, TestParseURL)
- Added Redis to docker-compose.yml
- Updated apps/server/.env.example
- Updated go.work to include new package

Ready for integration testing when Docker/Redis is available.
